name: Seiten Kishi Angem Knights -Nikuetsu ni Kudakareta Heroine no Densetsu-
original_name: 聖天姫使エンジェムナイツ-肉悦に砕かれたヒロインの伝説-
source:
Justice transforming heroines are put through a course of relentless violations in this ADV game!
The refined and beautiful heroines get completely defeated and corrupted in misery.

Their dignity is collapsed with all measures possible, and their inner lewdness,
which ones on the justice side shouldn't have, will be exposed before people. 

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE236787.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
正义变身女主角在这款冒险游戏中遭受无休止的侵犯！端庄美丽的女主角将在痛苦中彻底败北、堕落。

她们的尊严会被一切可能的手段摧毁，原本站在正义一方、不该拥有的内在淫荡也会暴露在众人面前。

[改编自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE236787.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
